turns.text: You people are thieves and liars. I will come to the studio and smash the frames if you ignore me.

I'm sorry you're upset. I've passed your message to a colleague, who will take over and follow up with you. If you'd like help with an order, please send the order number and the email it was placed with.

input.summary: Customer called the shop thieves and liars and threatened to come to the studio and smash frames if ignored. No order number or email given, so the customer is not verified and no order was looked up or changed. Needs a person to respond to the complaint.
